regions.full_page: Mrs. Augusta Feeney (nonCatholic) desiring to receive "Jesus in the Blessed Sacrament" to whom, in a special maner she had been praying for 30 days - "Jesus In The Blessed Sacrament have Mercy On Us!" became a Catholic received Every thing, surprised every one by reviving, after receiving the holy sacraments and living three days longer.

regions.full_page: Mrs. Feeney at 11 P.M. peacefully born into eternity with Jesus in her heart and on her breast and His holy name whispered in her ears.

regions.full_page: Funeral M.C. at 11 A.M. for same Augusta Feeney. After Mass Fr. Solan. made a few charitable remarks and ex- horted all to imitate "Our poor little deceased sister's example - not necesarily in becoming Catholics "- but in God's Name I do exhort you to implore The Most High to give you a will in conformithy with His will, a will to love and embrace His will at all times and at every cost .--- Then no doubt we shall have the happiness of know ing the truth of loving and embracing the truth and the truth will make you free.
